requiredClaims.meaning: The handoff records a loopback-only TCP listener at 127.0.0.1:7768 and wildcard IPv4 listener at 0.0.0.0:57621.
The handoff records enabled Public inbound TCP and UDP Any-port rules with RemoteAddress Any.
The handoff reports dynamic TCP/UDP port use; a single high port alone does not prove dynamic selection.
Reported Query User rule names support a Windows user-consent origin inference.
The physical identity of peer-B contacted at TCP 8009 remains unknown.
Reported Any-port permission exceeds the observed listener ports; this does not establish all ports needed.
